records.claim: For academic-year 2026/2027 higher-education study visas, Italian diplomatic guidance uses a minimum reference amount of €10,179.85 per year for means of subsistence. The funds must be lawful and traceable; this amount is separate from tuition and return-travel costs, and the competent mission may require supporting financial evidence.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Italian diplomatic missions
records.methodology: Direct review of official Italian diplomatic guidance for 2026/2027 and 2027/2028 higher-education study visas; the amount is recorded as a current reference requirement rather than generalized to every study-visa category.
